variant.description: Effort / harness / fallback settings the score was produced under.

asOf.description: Research cut-off for everything in this file.

watchlist.description: Announced or rumoured models we are tracking but cannot onboard yet.

processor.description: Who processes prompts/outputs on this route, e.g. "AWS (Bedrock)" or "Anthropic (independent processor)".

taiwanResidency.description: Whether any option keeps processing inside Taiwan.

enterpriseNotes.description: Taiwan-enterprise specific notes: residency, zh-TW quality, regulation.

unverified.description: Facts the research job could not verify from a primary source.

geography.description: Human description of where data is processed, e.g. "Japan (ap-northeast-1/3)".

id.description: The id you put in `model`, e.g. "jp.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5".

conflicts.description: Other published dates for the same event.  - "conflicting": another current official page shows this date. Plan to the earliest    (builders keep `date` = the earliest current date).  - "superseded": an older announcement replaced by the current source. Show as history only    (a reminder that dates move, sometimes earlier) — never count down to it.

scopeNote.description: Regions / deployment types the event applies to.

LifecycleStatus.description: CSP-side lifecycle state of a model on one channel.

knownPitfalls.description: Cross-model parameter pitfalls seen through the gateway.

minVersionBundledCostMap.description: Oldest image with the model in the bundled cost map (LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=true).

minVersionParams.description: Oldest version with correct parameter handling for this model family.

minVersionRouting.description: Oldest version that can route the model when the remote cost map is reloaded.

supported.description: Inside LiteLLM's "four most recent stable lines" window at `asOf`.

id.description: Canonical slug, stable across CSPs, e.g. "claude-opus-5-5".

platformStatus.description: Decision on YOUR platform. Seeded as "evaluating" for new models.

releaseDate.description: First public release by the vendor (any channel).

summary.description: One-paragraph zh-TW summary for list views.

vendorModelId.description: Vendor first-party model id (Anthropic API / OpenAI API / Gemini API).

Offering.description: One route: a model on one cloud service.

apacAvailability.description: Regions most relevant to a Taiwan-based enterprise (TW / JP / KR / SG / AU / IN).

aliases.description: Stable aliases on your gateway -> concrete targets.

metrics.description: All latency values are milliseconds; throughput is tokens/second.

route.description: Gateway alias that was called, e.g. "claude-opus-5-5@bedrock-jp".

PerformanceReference.description: External speed/latency reference (e.g. Artificial Analysis). Your own runs go in PerfRun.

ttftSec.description: Seconds to first token as defined by the source (reasoning models: often includes thinking).

PlatformStatus.description: Internal platform decision for a model (your gateway), not the CSP state.

cacheWrite.description: Cache write at the default TTL (5 min for Anthropic, 30 min for OpenAI on Bedrock).

alwaysOn.description: True when thinking cannot be switched off (e.g. Claude Opus 5.5).

metricDefinitions.description: Standard definitions the portal should display next to performance numbers.

behaviours.description: Behaviours that change what the API returns (refusal routing, watermarking, etc.).

classifications.description: Vendor risk classification, e.g. "OpenAI Preparedness: Cyber = Critical".

programmes.description: Trusted-access programmes relevant to security / life-science teams.

note.description: Optional pointer inside the source, e.g. a table name or section.

Verification.description: How much to trust a fact. `derived` = computed by us from other official facts.
